name: Yearly County-Level Counts
description: Yearly county-level dataset of hospitalizations, mortality, and demographic statistics for Medicare beneficiaries, including death counts and population characteristics.

content.n_bene: Int64: Number of beneficiaries in County
content.n_dead: Int64: Number of deaths in County in given year
content.female_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries that are female
content.dual_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with dual Medicaid enrollment
content.age_65_75_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with age [65, 75]
content.age_76_85_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with age (75, 85]
content.age_86_95_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with age (85, 95]
content.age_96_105_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with age (96, 105]
content.age_106_115_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with age (106,115]
content.race_black_pct: Float64: Percent of Black or African American beneficiaries
content.race_hispanic_pct: Float64: Percent of Hispanic or Latino beneficiaries
content.race_asian_pct: Float64: Percent of Asian or Asian American beneficiaries
